The patio site is ten spaces of an 81-space legal nonconforming public parking lot behind the building; it had run as the restaurant's patio since December 2020 under a temporary Shared Spaces permit.

unsure: licence_type: left null because no licence is 'sought'; the project enlarges the premises of the Type 47 licence already held (recorded under licences_already_held). A reader who treats the licence in play as the licence sought would write '47'.
floor_area_sqft: the record gives the indoor unit (1,952 sq ft) and the outdoor area (1,777 sq ft) separately and never a combined figure; 1,952 is the indoor use only.
changes_existing_business: the record says 'expand' (enlarge). The motion also adds a Nighttime Entertainment use to the restaurant but never calls that an intensification.
outdoor_area: the patio is both at the rear of the building and inside the public parking lot; 'parking_lot' chosen, 'rear_or_side' is equally true. It is not at the front.

closing_hour is the indoor business. Outdoor area hours are a separate fact with no field: sponsor asked for 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. Sun-Thu and to midnight Fri-Sat (staff summary quoted in triggers.json); Condition 20 limits it to 9 a.m.-10 p.m.
opening_hour: varies by day (4 p.m. Mon-Thu, 3 p.m. Fri, 2 p.m. Sat-Sun, motion finding 6.B), so no single value.
seats / occupants: the motion gives only 'approximately 86 additional patrons' for the outdoor area, not a seat count or a total occupancy.

entertainment_kind, live_entertainment, amplified_sound: the motion adds a Nighttime Entertainment use and mentions 'live music, if permitted by the Entertainment Commission' and 'entertainment activities such as live and amplified music would be subject to permitting'; it does not name a permit type or commit to either, so all three are null.
legacy_business: read as 'a Legacy Business is displaced or replaced'; the motion says none is affected. The record does not say whether Casements itself is on the Registry.
formula_retail: not mentioned in the motion or triggers.json.

record_facts.existing_use_text: Bar, 985 sq ft, ground story (Legacy North Beach Bar), authorised by Motion No. 14933 (Case 1999.485C, 2 Dec 1999) as 'a bar with live entertainment (non-amplified acoustic music)'; its Condition 3 limited entertainment to non-amplified music on set days and hours.
record_facts.prior_approval_limits: Planning Commission Motion No. 14933 (Case No. 1999.485C, 2 Dec 1999) authorised a bar with live entertainment (non-amplified acoustic music). Its Condition 3 allows only non-amplified live musical entertainment, with no speakers, amplifiers or microphones, on set days and hours (e.g. Sunday 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.). The project changes Condition 3 to allow amplified live entertainment between noon and 1:30 a.m. daily.
